substitution_attempted: No attempt was made because the client required the named worker to perform the services personally.
decides_what_work_and_what_order: The client assigns tasks through its operations coordinator and sets their order each morning.
decides_how_work_performed: The worker follows the client's documented procedures and has limited discretion over the method.
hours_and_location_set: Hours are fixed at 8:30 to 17:00, Monday to Friday, at the client's premises.
report_to_a_manager: The worker reports directly to the warehouse manager and attends a short daily briefing.
defective_work_corrected: The client arranges and pays for correction of errors, unless they were caused by deliberate misconduct.
loss_on_engagement: The worker cannot realistically make a loss because they receive an hourly wage and supply no significant materials.
presented_as_part_of_organisation: The worker wears the client's uniform and is listed on the internal staff rota. Customers are introduced to them as a member of the client's team.
staff_benefits_training_management: They receive paid induction training and use the same staff facilities as employees, but do not receive the full holiday package.
practical_bar: The fixed weekday schedule makes other regular work practically impossible. Occasional evening work elsewhere would be possible.

substitution_attempted: The contractor proposed a substitute during a family emergency. The client interviewed the person and rejected them because they lacked the required site accreditation.
decides_what_work_and_what_order: The contractor accepts projects from a statement of work and decides which deliverables to tackle first.
decides_how_work_performed: The contractor chooses the technical approach, software, and workflow, subject to the agreed specification.
hours_and_location_set: No hours are prescribed; meetings are usually remote, with occasional access to the client's office by arrangement.
report_to_a_manager: There is no line manager. The contractor sends progress updates to a project contact who checks deliverables.
defective_work_corrected: The contractor must correct defects at their own expense within the agreed warranty period. They normally do the remedial work themselves.
loss_on_engagement: A fixed fee means the contractor can lose money if the work takes longer than estimated or subcontracting costs rise.
presented_as_part_of_organisation: The contractor uses their own business name on correspondence and is not shown on the staff directory. External communications identify them as an independent supplier.
staff_benefits_training_management: No employee benefits are provided. The contractor completed one client security briefing but receives no ongoing training or supervision.
practical_bar: Other work is expressly permitted and the contractor has several concurrent clients. Deadlines are the only practical constraint.

substitution_attempted: A substitute designer covered three weeks of work and was accepted after a basic portfolio check. The worker paid the substitute directly.
decides_what_work_and_what_order: The worker chooses which assignments to accept from a shared brief list and sequences the work independently.
decides_how_work_performed: The worker determines the creative method, tools, and review process, provided the final assets meet the brief.
hours_and_location_set: The worker sets their own hours and works mainly from a home studio, attending planned client meetings.
report_to_a_manager: There is no manager. A brand lead provides feedback on drafts but does not direct the worker's day-to-day activity.
defective_work_corrected: The worker revises rejected work without an additional fee where it falls outside the agreed brief. Major changes requested later are charged separately.
loss_on_engagement: The worker bears the cost of wasted design time and can make a loss if revisions exceed the quoted allowance.
presented_as_part_of_organisation: They use their own email signature and are not presented as staff. Their portfolio and trading name appear on proposals.
staff_benefits_training_management: There are no benefits or formal training. Feedback is limited to scheduled creative reviews.
practical_bar: The worker regularly fits other commissions around this engagement. There is no practical restriction beyond agreed delivery dates.

substitution_attempted: No attempt was made; the service agreement and client practice required personal attendance.
decides_what_work_and_what_order: The clinic's rota manager allocates appointments and determines the order of patient visits.
decides_how_work_performed: The worker uses professional judgment, but the clinic sets mandatory protocols and treatment documentation standards.
hours_and_location_set: The clinic sets regular shifts and requires the worker to attend its treatment rooms.
report_to_a_manager: The worker reports to the clinical lead, who reviews records and discusses any incidents.
defective_work_corrected: The clinic handles patient follow-up and correction. The worker may be asked to repeat an assessment but does not usually bear the financial cost.
loss_on_engagement: There is little opportunity for a loss because payment is hourly and equipment is supplied by the clinic.
presented_as_part_of_organisation: The worker appears on the clinic rota and introduces themselves using the clinic's name. Patients generally perceive them as part of the clinic staff.
staff_benefits_training_management: They receive mandatory clinical training and regular supervision, but no pension or paid holiday benefits.
practical_bar: The rota and exclusivity arrangement leave little practical capacity for other work during the engagement.

substitution_attempted: The worker once sent a colleague to an installation, but the client required prior approval and the colleague was not accepted. The worker then completed the job personally.
decides_what_work_and_what_order: The client issues jobs through a portal and determines the priority of each call-out.
decides_how_work_performed: The worker chooses the practical method but must follow the client's safety checklist and installation standards.
hours_and_location_set: The client specifies appointment windows and customer locations, while travel between jobs is arranged by the worker.
report_to_a_manager: A field-services supervisor monitors completion and is available for escalations, though there is no continuous supervision.
defective_work_corrected: The worker returns without charge to correct workmanship defects within 30 days. The client pays for faults caused by supplied materials.
loss_on_engagement: The worker can lose money through unpaid travel, wasted visits, or buying small replacement parts.
presented_as_part_of_organisation: The worker wears a branded jacket and uses a client-issued job application. Customers may assume they are part of the client's service team.
staff_benefits_training_management: The worker receives an online safety induction but no employee benefits. Performance is monitored through customer ratings and completion reports.
practical_bar: Other work is possible, although the client's appointment windows often occupy the most useful daytime slots.

substitution_attempted: The contractor used a small network of approved specialists on two occasions. The client was notified but did not interview or approve each individual.
decides_what_work_and_what_order: The contractor proposes a backlog and agrees milestones with the client, then controls the order of delivery.
decides_how_work_performed: The contractor decides the method and may delegate technical tasks, subject only to acceptance criteria.
hours_and_location_set: Work is performed at times chosen by the contractor, mostly remotely. Site visits are arranged when testing is necessary.
report_to_a_manager: There is no manager or daily reporting line; fortnightly steering meetings cover risks and completed milestones.
defective_work_corrected: The contractor is responsible for fixing defects identified during acceptance at their own cost. Third-party specialist costs are paid from the contractor's fee.
loss_on_engagement: The contractor carries a meaningful risk of loss if subcontractor charges or rework exceed the fixed project price.
presented_as_part_of_organisation: The contractor is presented as an external consultancy and uses its own branding. It has no internal title or staff profile.
staff_benefits_training_management: No benefits or internal training are provided. The contractor manages its own team and attends only project governance meetings.
practical_bar: The consultancy serves several clients and can accept other projects, subject to meeting the agreed milestones.

substitution_attempted: No attempt was made. The worker was engaged for their personal knowledge of the client's records.
decides_what_work_and_what_order: The compliance director assigns cases and sets deadlines, usually in a weekly work queue.
decides_how_work_performed: The worker follows the client's templates and escalation rules, with some discretion over research and drafting.
hours_and_location_set: Core hours are 10:00 to 16:00, with work split between the client's office and approved home working.
report_to_a_manager: The worker reports to the compliance director and has monthly one-to-one meetings.
defective_work_corrected: The worker revises inaccurate reports during paid time. The client bears the cost of any resulting administrative rework.
loss_on_engagement: The worker has no significant financial exposure and is paid for time spent, whether or not a particular case is completed.
presented_as_part_of_organisation: The worker has a company email address and appears in the internal directory. External contacts are told they are working on behalf of the client.
staff_benefits_training_management: They receive data-protection training and regular supervision, but are excluded from the client's bonus scheme.
practical_bar: Part-time hours leave room for other work, although confidentiality obligations prevent work for direct competitors.

substitution_attempted: The worker suggested a replacement after an injury, but the client required a named person with the same certification. No replacement was ultimately used.
decides_what_work_and_what_order: The client schedules each event and allocates the worker's duties in a detailed run sheet.
decides_how_work_performed: The worker can use personal judgment in dealing with visitors, but the client dictates the event procedures and script.
hours_and_location_set: Shift times and venues are fixed by the client and can include early mornings and weekends.
report_to_a_manager: The worker reports to the event manager during every shift and receives instructions through a radio channel.
defective_work_corrected: If duties are missed, the client arranges cover or a repeat visit and generally absorbs the cost. The worker may lose the shift fee for serious non-attendance.
loss_on_engagement: The worker cannot normally make a loss beyond unpaid time or travel because the client supplies the materials.
presented_as_part_of_organisation: The worker wears the client's event uniform and is introduced to attendees as part of the event team.
staff_benefits_training_management: A short induction is required for each venue, with close shift supervision. No broader staff benefits are available.
practical_bar: The irregular but long shifts make it difficult to accept other bookings on event days. Work on non-event days remains possible.

substitution_attempted: The sole trader used an associate for routine data cleansing without seeking permission. The client accepted the completed files and paid the sole trader.
decides_what_work_and_what_order: The worker receives a broad data objective and decides which datasets and tasks to process first.
decides_how_work_performed: The worker chooses the software, validation approach, and working method, provided the output meets the agreed schema.
hours_and_location_set: There are no fixed hours or location requirements. The work is completed from the worker's own office.
report_to_a_manager: The worker has a client contact for questions but no manager, supervision, or routine reporting obligation.
defective_work_corrected: The worker must correct rejected files at no extra charge. Any assistant they hire is paid by the worker.
loss_on_engagement: The fixed fee creates a modest risk of loss from inefficient processing, software subscriptions, or subcontracting.
presented_as_part_of_organisation: The worker uses an independent business name and is not included in the client's organisational chart. They communicate as an outside data service.
staff_benefits_training_management: There are no benefits or training beyond a short briefing on the client's file format.
practical_bar: The worker is free to take other jobs and has done so throughout the engagement.

substitution_attempted: No attempt was made; the engagement letter states that the named analyst must perform the work.
decides_what_work_and_what_order: The client assigns analysis tickets and reprioritises them through a team leader.
decides_how_work_performed: The worker chooses how to investigate issues but uses the client's mandatory tools, controls, and review process.
hours_and_location_set: The worker is expected online during 9:00 to 17:30 and attends the client's office two days each week.
report_to_a_manager: The worker reports to the analytics manager, joins team stand-ups, and receives quarterly performance feedback.
defective_work_corrected: Errors are corrected by the worker during subsequent paid hours, with the team absorbing any wider rework.
loss_on_engagement: There is no realistic risk of financial loss because payment is based on time and the client provides the required systems.
presented_as_part_of_organisation: The worker has a client laptop, email address, and permanent desk. Internally and externally they are presented as part of the analytics function.
staff_benefits_training_management: They attend team training and receive supervised onboarding, but have no paid leave or employee bonus.
practical_bar: The full-time schedule and exclusivity clause make other work impractical during the engagement.

substitution_attempted: The worker arranged for a qualified colleague to cover one shift. The client approved the colleague after checking insurance and certification, and the worker paid them.
decides_what_work_and_what_order: The client sets the daily cleaning schedule and determines which areas must be completed first.
decides_how_work_performed: The worker follows the client's cleaning standards but chooses the detailed sequence and products within safety limits.
hours_and_location_set: The client specifies evening shifts and the building location, with a small amount of flexibility around start time.
report_to_a_manager: The worker reports completion to the facilities supervisor and receives occasional inspection feedback.
defective_work_corrected: The worker must return to rectify missed areas without another payment. They pay any helper used for the work.
loss_on_engagement: The worker can make a small loss if replacement labour, supplies, or extra travel costs exceed the agreed fee.
presented_as_part_of_organisation: The worker wears a plain access badge and is known to building staff as an external cleaner. They are not included in the client's employee directory.
staff_benefits_training_management: They receive a site induction and occasional safety reminders, but no benefits or close supervision.
practical_bar: Evening shifts leave daytime availability for other clients, and the worker has several smaller cleaning contracts.

substitution_attempted: The consultant delegated part of the research to a junior researcher without seeking approval. The client accepted the report from the consultant as the contracting party.
decides_what_work_and_what_order: The consultant agreed the outcome with the client and independently planned the research stages and order.
decides_how_work_performed: The consultant selects the methodology, interview format, and analysis tools.
hours_and_location_set: There are no set hours or required workplace. Interviews are booked around participant availability.
report_to_a_manager: The consultant reports on milestones to a sponsor but is not managed day to day.
defective_work_corrected: The consultant must amend work that fails the agreed scope without extra payment. Rework by any assistant is funded from the project fee.
loss_on_engagement: The consultant bears the risk of lost time and can make a substantial loss if recruitment or research costs exceed the quote.
presented_as_part_of_organisation: The consultant uses a separate company identity and is described in documents as an external adviser. They are not presented as a member of the client's workforce.
staff_benefits_training_management: No benefits or internal training are offered. The client provides only a project briefing and access to relevant documents.
practical_bar: The consultant can accept other work and has reserved only agreed milestone dates for this project.

substitution_attempted: No attempt was made. The client required the worker's personal attendance at each scheduled lesson.
decides_what_work_and_what_order: The school sets the curriculum, lesson timetable, and order of topics.
decides_how_work_performed: The teacher chooses classroom examples and teaching style within the school's curriculum and safeguarding rules.
hours_and_location_set: Teaching hours and classroom location are fixed by the school timetable, with preparation done at home.
report_to_a_manager: The teacher reports to the head of department and attends termly planning meetings.
defective_work_corrected: The school manages missed or inadequate lessons through additional teaching or reassignment. The teacher does not normally pay the correction cost.
loss_on_engagement: There is minimal financial risk because the teacher is paid per teaching session and uses school facilities.
presented_as_part_of_organisation: Students and parents are told that the teacher is part of the school faculty. The teacher uses school systems and an institutional email address.
staff_benefits_training_management: The teacher attends safeguarding training and receives regular departmental guidance, but is not eligible for the school's pension scheme.
practical_bar: The school timetable occupies set weekdays, leaving limited but usable time for private tutoring outside those hours.

substitution_attempted: A substitute was proposed for a weekend delivery run but failed the client's driving and security checks. The worker completed the run instead.
decides_what_work_and_what_order: The client provides the delivery list and route priorities. The worker can adjust the sequence for traffic or access reasons.
decides_how_work_performed: The worker chooses the route and loading method but must comply with the client's scanning and proof-of-delivery procedures.
hours_and_location_set: The client sets collection times and delivery windows, while the worker starts from a chosen depot.
report_to_a_manager: The worker has a dispatch contact who tracks progress and handles exceptions, but no continuous manager.
defective_work_corrected: The worker must revisit failed deliveries at their own cost where the failure was due to their error. Customer-caused failures are paid separately.
loss_on_engagement: Fuel, vehicle maintenance, parking, and unpaid return journeys can leave the worker with a loss.
presented_as_part_of_organisation: The vehicle is unbranded and the worker invoices under a trading name. Recipients see them as an independent courier rather than client staff.
staff_benefits_training_management: A short app and safety induction is required, but there are no benefits and little direct supervision.
practical_bar: The delivery windows occupy much of the daytime, but the worker takes evening and weekend routes for other clients.

substitution_attempted: The contractor named an assistant who met the stated qualification requirements. The client approved the assistant, and the contractor paid them from the project fee.
decides_what_work_and_what_order: The contractor agrees outcomes with the client and chooses the order in which the audit areas are examined.
decides_how_work_performed: The contractor selects the audit approach and working papers, subject to professional standards and the agreed scope.
hours_and_location_set: The contractor sets working hours and works remotely, with occasional pre-arranged visits to the client's premises.
report_to_a_manager: The contractor presents findings to a finance director but is not subject to line management.
defective_work_corrected: The contractor corrects errors in the final report without further charge. The cost of assistant time and any extra checking remains with the contractor.
loss_on_engagement: The fixed fee exposes the contractor to loss if records are incomplete or the assistant requires extensive supervision.
presented_as_part_of_organisation: The contractor uses an independent practice name and is described as an external auditor. They have no employee title or internal reporting position.
staff_benefits_training_management: No benefits or training are provided, apart from a client confidentiality briefing.
practical_bar: Other engagements are actively undertaken, with this work scheduled around fixed reporting deadlines.

substitution_attempted: No attempt was made because the worker was recruited for a role requiring direct access to confidential client accounts.
decides_what_work_and_what_order: The account director assigns client portfolios and prioritises requests through a shared queue.
decides_how_work_performed: The worker follows scripted processes and approval limits set by the company, with little choice over method.
hours_and_location_set: The company sets shifts between 7:00 and 19:00 and requires attendance at its contact centre.
report_to_a_manager: The worker reports to a team leader, attends daily huddles, and is subject to call-quality monitoring.
defective_work_corrected: The company handles customer remediation and quality corrections. The worker may receive coaching but does not pay for the correction.
loss_on_engagement: The worker bears no meaningful commercial risk and is paid for scheduled hours.
presented_as_part_of_organisation: The worker uses the company's phone system, email, badge, and scripts. Customers are told they are speaking to a company representative.
staff_benefits_training_management: They receive structured induction, ongoing coaching, and access to selected staff discounts, but not the full permanent employee package.

substitution_attempted: The gardener sent a trained helper for two visits and informed the client afterwards. The client accepted the work without requiring approval.
decides_what_work_and_what_order: The gardener agrees the seasonal outcome with the property owner and chooses the order of tasks on each visit.
decides_how_work_performed: The gardener decides the planting, pruning, and maintenance methods, taking account of the client's preferences.

report_to_a_manager: There is no manager or formal reporting line. The gardener sends photographs and an occasional progress note.
defective_work_corrected: The gardener returns to correct poor workmanship at their own cost. Replacement plants are chargeable where the failure was caused by the client's instructions.
loss_on_engagement: The gardener can make a loss through plant mortality, weather delays, fuel costs, or paying a helper more than expected.
presented_as_part_of_organisation: The gardener trades under a distinctive local business name and is clearly presented as an outside contractor.
staff_benefits_training_management: No benefits or training are provided. The gardener manages any helper and works without client supervision.

substitution_attempted: The consultant asked to use a colleague for a client workshop. Approval was refused because the colleague had not completed the client's security induction.

presented_as_part_of_organisation: They are introduced as an independent facilitator and use their own branded materials, although the client logo appears on the event slides.
staff_benefits_training_management: There are no benefits or regular training. The client provides a one-hour briefing on internal terminology and policies.
practical_bar: Only the agreed workshop dates are blocked, leaving substantial capacity for other clients.

decides_what_work_and_what_order: The worker selects which jobs to take from those offered.
